summary: CERO Therapeutics filed an 8-K regarding a second amended and restated promissory note with SRX Global Inc. The note allows borrowings up to $2,085,200, with $750,000 initially funded and additional tranches. It bears 10% interest, matures May 28, 2027, and is convertible into common stock at the lower of $0.05 or 80% of the average of the five lowest intraday prices over 20 prior days, subject to a 4.99% ownership cap. A resale registration statement will be filed. This is a debt financing with conversion rights, not a special situation like a going-private or tender offer.
